mapper.sql:
where membership.clan_id=#{criteria.clanId} and app_user.deleted_at is null
and exists (select 1 from member_role visible_role where visible_role.membership_id=membership.id and visible_role.status='active' and ( (visible_role.scope_type=#{criteria.branchScope} and visible_role.scope_id in #{id})false or (visible_role.scope_type=#{criteria.branchSubtreeScope} and visible_role.scope_id in #{id})false ))
and membership.member_status in #{v}and false
and (lower(app_user.username) like concat('%',#{criteria.keyword},'%') or lower(app_user.display_name) like concat('%',#{criteria.keyword},'%'))
and exists(select 1 from member_role mr join app_role role on role.id=mr.role_id where mr.membership_id=membership.id and mr.status='active' and role.role_code in #{v})and false
and exists(select 1 from member_role scoped where scoped.membership_id=membership.id and scoped.status='active' and scoped.scope_type in #{v})and false
mapper.select: select distinct membership.* from clan_membership membership join app_user on app_user.id=membership.user_id order by membership.id asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(distinct membership.id) from clan_membership membership join app_user on app_user.id=membership.user_id
